name: cometchat
description: CometChat AI-coding skills — add real-time chat, voice/video calls, and AI features to any React, Next.js, React Router, Astro, React Native, Angular, native Android, native iOS, or Flutter project via your AI coding agent.

plugins.name: cometchat-skills
plugins.description: 100+ skills across six families (web / native React Native / Angular / Android V5+V6 / iOS V5 / Flutter V5+V6) for integrating CometChat. The /cometchat dispatcher detects your framework, asks only what the API can't infer, and writes a working chat integration. cometchat apply-feature toggles 30+ features (polls, reactions, smart replies, calls, link preview, message translation, ...) without leaving the terminal.
